verdict.rationale: The official `wezterm cli` can spawn programs and manipulate tabs and panes in a running GUI or mux instance. A runtime probe confirmed scripted `spawn --new-window`, `send-text` and `list` working, so a workspace can be scripted into one command. The evidence only shows this via external scripting against the CLI, not a declarative startup-session or layout definition in the Lua config. Missing for 10: documented config-level startup/session hooks, explicit pane-split layout definitions, named workspace/session restore, and independent reports of one-command project workspaces.
